name: @arena/escalation-observability-service
description: Arena escalation-observability reference service (Work Order C021; issue #127). In-process read/projection service over @arena/escalation-observability: subscribes to the C001/C011/C010/C015 surfaces through INJECTED PUBLIC ports (the escalation event stream, the engagement SLA clocks, the payment-state refs, the C015 routing decisions — data-in seams only, never writes into another surface's state), materializes lifecycle timelines + measured SLA records as DURABLE IDEMPOTENT JOBS on the A015-discipline reference fabric (correlation-addressable, idempotency-key REQUIRED — lock rule 17), and serves the ops query surface: per-escalation timelines, per-tenant SLA overviews with met/at-risk/breached vocabulary, dimensional SLO rollups with disclosed formulas and small-sample suppression, network-health signals and alert-rule projections. Projections own no domain truth (spec/service-boundaries.md): there is NO code path that mutates an escalation, engagement, payment or routing record. Cross-tenant reads fail closed (TENANT_MISMATCH); a measured SLA-met record not backed by resolved events fails closed (the domain evidence law); tampered store entries fail closed with digest re-verification.
